So your love can sound like you’re asking them to trust you. It doesn’t need their trust, but it does need you to be honest with them, which isn’t the same as perfect.
The love can go first, though, before their trust is done going over your track record (they’ve heard what you still call yourself when you mess up, sometimes out loud).
